name: Bear Attack
steps: Drag balloon to younger brother to lift him up.
Drag mushroom to older sister to disguise her.
Tap garage to reveal ninja, then drag costume to older brother.
Drag tire to dad to make him stronger.
Drag shovel to ground to dig a trap.
Tap door to let mom go inside safely.
Tap garage, then tap motorcycle for grandpa to ride out.
Drag white paint to grandma to turn her into polar bear.
Drag black paint to add face details.
Tap grandma to defeat the bear and finish level.
